cs_pin.docs:
**int**: The SPI cable select pin to use.

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id to use for this MCP3008 component.

mcp3008_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id of the parent MCP3008 component.

number.docs:
**int**: The pin number of the MCP3008.

**float**: The reference voltage. Defaults to `3.3V`.

*See also: [MCP3008 8-Channel 10-Bit A/D Converter](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/mcp3008#sensor)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `1s`.

*See also: [MCP3008 8-Channel 10-Bit A/D Converter](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/mcp3008#sensor)*
